Commentary.Commentary: Okay. We have one finalist. Who will be the other? Pakistan or India? That mouth-watering contest is set to be played on Tuesday, 30th January, 2018 at this very same venue, Hagley Oval, Christchurch at 1030 local (2130 GMT, previous day). Hopefully, it will not be as one-sided as this one. See ya then! ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

A smiling victorious Australia captain Jason Sangha says that there has been a lot of hard work put in for reaching this stage. Says that he is impressed a lot by the Afghan spinners and calls them a bountiful of talent. Adds that he anyways wanted to bowl first and the conditions worked in his team's favour. Praises Edwards for the innings he played. On picking the spinners, he says one needed to settle down initially but is still not sure whether he would still be able to pick them. On watching the semi-final tomorrow, he says that he is a pretty boring person and prefers to chill away from the game. Is confident, he says regarding the final, be it India or Pakistan and adds that the team is geared up for it.

Afghanistan skipper, Naveen-ul-Haq, says that his team was 40-50 runs short. Says that his side had a couple of unlucky dismissals down the leg side, of which one was not out. Does not want to comment on that. Is proud of his team and says that every one is a match-winner. Is also proud that they have made it to the semi-final of the World Cup and assures that they will put in one last step to finish third.

MAN OF THE MATCH, JACK EDWARDS, says that they had done some research on the Afghan spinners and wanted to attack the new balls before the spinners took effect. Admits that it is very difficult to pick them. Admits he struggled quite a few times but got away with those. On his big hits, he says that he was trying to hit straight and backed himself. On the wicket, he says that a batsman needed time to settle in before playing his shots. Thinks for a while and then says that he will be watching the India-Pakistan semi-final tomorrow.

All eyes were on the Afghanistan spinners when they came out to defend. But Australia were ready. They came out hard, lost an early wicket but Jack Edwards took the game away. He was dropped on 8, a fairly simple chance and he made the Asians pay. He ended up with 72 from 65 balls and when he got out, the target was down to 53 from 149 balls. The middle order made use of the opportunity to spend some time at the crease and took Australia home comfortably. Presentation coming up...

Ryan Hadley and Zak Evans set the tone in Powerplay 1, conceding just 27 runs. The other bowlers maintained the pressure and eventually restricted the Asian side to 181. Jonathan Merlo picked up 4 wickets. Also, there were a couple of unlucky dismissals for Afghanistan with the bat.
One-sided game. Not quite expected. Australia were touted as favourites but by only 55 percent before the start of the game. However, their fast bowlers have taken them into the final.
AUSTRALIA ARE INTO THE FINAL! For the 5th time. Outside off, McSweeney punches it through covers and comes back for the third! Victory with 6 wickets and 75 balls to spare!
Very full outside off, steered behind point for a very well run couple. 50-RUN STAND comes up, consuming 73 balls but has looked assuring.
A full toss outside off, driven straight to cover.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
Mujeeb Zadran is back on.
Full and outside off, eased to cover.
Down the leg side, turned towards square leg for a single.

Great effort. Short and outside off, Uppal cuts it through point and finds the gap. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gives it a good chase, gets to the ball and pulls it back in. However, he signals  a boundary to the umpire. But hang on, the replays show that he has saved the boundary! Three runs given. Australia a hit away now.
Outside off, driven towards Darwish Rasooli at extra cover who fumbles again and concedes a single. 9 more needed now.

Huge appeal for a caught behind! Turned down! The Afghans look shocked. And rightly so. Full and outside off, McSweeney looks to drive but misses. There is a big noise heard and they appeal but the umpire stays put. Replays detect a thick outside edge.
Zahir Khan is back on.

That took off! OUCH. A bouncer by a spinner, outside off, seam-up, Param gets out of the way but the poor keeper, tries to save his head and outs his gloves in the way. Wrings his hands in pain. A MAIDEN. 10-2-35-2 are the figures for Qais. Well tried, lad.
Full on middle, flicked straight to widish mid on.
Short and outside off, cut straight to backward point.
Full and outside off, Uppal lunges and shoulders arms.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
Tossed up outside off, left alone.
Qais Ahmad is back on.
Full on middle, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, blocked to the off side.
On middle and off, flicked to short mid-wicket.
Full again, pushed straight to extra cover again.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to extra cover.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Mujeeb Zadran is back on.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point for another single. 12 from the over.
FOUR! Better shot. Another short ball, this time Uppal swings and pulls it in front of square leg for consecutive boundaries! The stand is worth 41 from 52 balls.
FOUR! Teeing off now. A short ball outside off, Uppal pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary. Moves to 23 from 30 balls. 16 more needed from 98 balls.
A short ball, around middle, pulled to long leg for one.
Outside off, steered behind point for a run.
A full toss on middle, pushed wide of mid on for a single.
FOUR! Finally finds the gap! He has been trying that shot for ages. Short and outside off, Uppal goes back and punches it in front of point for a boundary! The stand is worth 30 from 47 balls.
Short ball, outside leg, PU works it through mid-wicket and runs extremely hard to come back for the second. A better throw might have had him there.
Full on middle, watchfully blocked towards cover.
Short and outside off, Param goes back to cut but mistimes it to point.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Uppal gets across to tuck but misses. 29 more needed from 108 balls.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
A short ball on middle, McSweeney looks to hook but misses.
Short and outside off, Uppal gets on top of the bounce and steers it to third man for a run.
Pushes this past short mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, pushed towards mid off.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.
Naveen-ul-Haq is back on.

Huge appeal for a caught behind! The umpire stays calm. Uppal gets across to flick this one but misses. The keeper immediately jumps in appeal after collecting it but the umpire does not signal anything. No wide, so perhaps pad then.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a single. 150 UP FOR AUSTRALIA, 32 more needed from 115 balls.
Nice bowling, spins this one in, McSweeney pushes it towards cover.
On middle, watchfully defended from the crease.
The wrong 'un again, Uppal lunges to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge, on the bounce past slip to third man. Just a single. The stand is worth 20 from 31 balls.
The googly outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to point.
FOUR! That stays low, dropped short, McSweeney pulls it through square leg for a boundary! Moves to 11 from 22 balls.
Outside off, punched straight to cover.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short and outside off, McSweeney goes back and punches it in front of point for a boundary. 38 more needed from 124 balls.
Short and outside off, cut straight to cover.
Qais Ahmad is back.
Full and outside off, eased through cover-point for a run.
Another wrong 'un, another play and a miss.
Full and outside off the googly, McSweeney pushes but is beaten.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total. Moves to 10 from 18 balls.

EDGED, FOUR! Lucky escape for Uppal. Short and outside off, Uppal looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge which flies past the keeper and Naveen-ul-Haq is standing too wide at slip! Away she races to the third man fence!
Zahir Khan is back on.
Down the leg side, flicked past short fine leg for a couple. Gets off the mark on his 13th ball. 48 more needed from 132 balls.
Full and outside off, blocked towards cover.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
WIDE. Lands it around middle, but then it spins down the leg side, past McSweeney's flick.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Short and outside off, Uppal misses out, cutting it straight to cover.
Mujeeb Zadran has been brought back.
Full and outside off, coming in, let through once again. Just 8 runs off the last 5 overs.
Full and wide outside off, cutting back in, left alone.
Landed outside off, cutting back in, punched straight to point.
Full again, pushed towards point.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.
Outside off, pushed wide of mid on for a single.
On middle and off, Qais looks to flick but gets a leading edge which does not carry to the bowler! A WICKET MAIDEN! Qais has figures of 8-1-27-2!
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.

An appeal now! Excitement is in the air. Similar ball to the previous one, once again Nathan comes forward to defend but the ball spins past the outside edge. The keeper collects and appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Things are happening now! Floated outside off, McSweeney lunges to defend but the ball spins past the outside edge!
Nathan McSweeney walks in at number 6, replacing Edwards.

OUT! Drags it on! Is the game turning? Tossed up outside off, slower through the air, Edwards reaches out for it and looks to drive hard but only gets a thick inside edge onto his stumps! Afghanistan sense something big. The main batsman is gone. A fine knock - 72 from 65 balls but the others are struggling on this pitch. Australia still need another 53 runs. Plenty of balls left but only 6 wickets remaining now.
Full and wide outside off, PU drives hard but meets thin air.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Around off, seaming in, pushed defensively towards cover.
Beautifully bowled. Full and outside off, Param comes forward to defend but the ball moves away and beats the outside edge.
Similar ball, this time it is left alone.

Good fielding. Short and outside off, Uppal cuts hard but gets a bottom edge past first slip. The ball races away to the fence but Zahir Khan races to his left from third man and dives to his left to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
Full on middle and off, nicely tucked through mid-wicket for a run. Afghanistan will not mind that, the new batsman taking the single on the last ball.
Full and outside off, pushed toward cover.
Around off, watchfully defended in front of first slip.
Full and outside off, steered through third man where there is an excellent diving stop made.

Full and outside off, solidly defended.
Landed outside off, swinging in, let through. 3 runs and a wicket from that over.
Full and outside off, swinging in, pushed towards cover.

OUT! Got him! Afghanistan get their third! Short and wide outside off, Merlo flashes at it without moving his feet and gets a thick nick behind! That limp was playiong on his mind, it seems, hence he did not move his feet. Another opening for the Asians. 57 runs needed for Australia, 7 wickets required for Afghanistan, 164 balls left.
Another short ball, nicely pulled through square leg for a couple. He is limping now... anything serious?
On a length outside off, dabbed straight to backward point.
Banged in short, pulled comfortably to deep square leg for a single. 59 more needed from 167 balls. The stand moves to 20 from 29 balls.
Short and around off, Jonathan looks to punch but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, blocked to the off side.

A bouncer to end the over, Edwards sways away.

A slower bouncer outside off, Jonathan looks to pull but is beaten.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! Short and outside off, Merlo cuts it behind point and finds the boundary! 67 more needed from 179 balls. The stand moves to 12 from 17 balls of which, Merlo has scored 10 from 14.
Back to pace. Naveen-ul-Haq has another try.
Short and outside off, cut straight to backward point.
Tossed up outside off, pushed down to long off for a run.
Shorter and quicker outside off, punched straight to cover.

Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Short and outside off, cut through sweeper cover for a single. Afghanistan would want to bowl more to Merlo.
On middle, Jonathan looks to tuck it to the leg side but has no idea about it and gets a leading edge which lands on the pitch.

Outside off, punched straight to point.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Is that the break the Afghans needed? Full on middle, Sangha comes forward and chips it straight back to the bowler. It is low but Qais gets across and scoops it just above the ground! He is up an running in celebration. Afghanistan are not giving up yet and they believe the match has opened up. End of a fine 77-run stand, 79 more needed from 196 balls.

Qais Ahmad changes ends.

Straighter on the stumps, defended from the crease.

Goes back and works it through mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat for a couple. 100 UP FOR AUSTRALIA. 82 more needed from 202 balls.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Mujeeb Zadran is back on.
Very full on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Nearly! The googly, coming back in sharply from outside off, Edwards looks to run it down to third man but misses. That did not miss the off stump by much.
Action replay of the previous three deliveries, only this was much fuller. The stand moves to 70 from 61 balls.
A full toss outside off, driven through the covers for one.
Outside off, pushed past cover for a run.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single. 89 more needed from 209 balls.
Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for another one.
Short and outside off, cut to point for a quick one. Moves to 20 from 30 balls.

Very full, punched down to long on for a run.

Almost a wicket! What a fielding effort. Full on middle and leg, Edwards looks to go big and swings this high in the air. Does not have the distance though and long on has a chance. Bahir Shah comes running in and dives but cannot get there. The ball trickles towards the opes but Ibrahim Zadran rushes across from long off and pulls it back in! Two runs taken. The googly, short on off, punched down to long on for another single.The stand moves to 60 from 50 balls.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Jason gets across and misses his tuck.

Full and wide outside off, driven through the covers for a run. 99 more needed from 219 balls now.
Beautifully bowled. Tosses this one outside off, Sangha comes foward looking to defend the leg spinner but it is the googly and spins past the outside edge.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, worked through square leg for another single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards long off for one.
Tossed up wide outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover where Darwish Rasooli misfields and concedes a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Outside off, punched through cover for a single to bring up the 50-RUN STAND in 37 balls.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.

EDGED, FOUR, FIFTY! Short and outside off, Edwards goes back and looks to cut but gets a bottom edge past short third man for a boundary! He has pushed Afghanistan right on the back foot with this knock. 108 more needed from 231 balls.

SAFE. Full and outside off, Jack looks to run it down to third man but misses. The keeper whips off the bails and appeals for a stumping and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that the foot did come out of the crease but went back in before the stumping could be done.
Stumping appeal! Has Edwards made it in? Referred upstairs...
FOUR! SPANKED! Any opportunity and Edwards goes after it. Short on middle, pulled over square leg for a boundary!
Zahir Khan into the attack now.
Outside off, steered past backward point for a brace. The stand is worth 40 from 33 balls.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, pushed down to long on for a run.
Nothing shot. Stays in his crease and attempts a feeble run down to third man, does not move his feet and nearly edges it.
Landed outside off, run down past slip through backward point for a single. 119 more needed from 239 balls.
Qais Ahmad into the attack now.
POWERPLAY 2. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, run down past slip towards third man. The ball just stops inside the ropes and the batsmen return for the third. Sangha moves to 10 from 14 balls.
Down the leg side, Jason looks to defend but the ball goes off his pads behind. The keeper acrobatically dives to his left and appeals after taking the catch but to no avail.
EDGED but no slip again. Full and outside off, Sangha pushes forward but gets a thick outside edge through the vacant slip region to third man. Two runs taken.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! The foot is indeed touching the ropes. On a length outside off, Edwards punches this on the up through the covers. Two fielders chase after it, one from covers and the other from point. The former gets to the ball, slides and pulls it back in but while doing so, his right leg touches the ropes. Unlucky. The stand moves to 31 from 21 balls.
FOUR? Edwards has punched this through the covers and there has been a fielding attempt near the boundary. Has he touched the rope while pushing the ball back? Referred upstairs...
On a length outside off, coming in, defended calmly.
A short ball again, pulled with total control behind square leg for a single. 129 more needed from 248 balls.
A bouncer now, outside off, JS ducks.
Full and outside off, blocked towards backward point.
ANOTHER WIDE. Short and wide outside off, Jason looks to play the cut but the ball swings further away after pitching and beats him.
WIDE! Full and miles outside off, left alone.

Lucky. A short ball outside off, Sangha swivels to pull but the bounce gets big on him. Miscues it but the ball goes way beyond mid on running back. Two runs taken. 50 UP FOR AUSTRALIA! 132 more needed from 251 balls.
Outside off, JE tries to be cheeky, attempting a run down to third man but misses. 14 from the over.
Mid off drops back now.

SIX! This is even bigger! Tossed up wide outside off, Edwards reaches out and sends it sailing miles over long off! 134 more needed from 253 balls now. Edwards moves to 40 from 31 balls while this stand is worth 22 from 14!
Around off, coming back in, pushed back to the bowler.

SIX! That has a lot of authority written over! The first six of the match. Full and outside off, Edwards reaches out and lofts it with the spin over long off! Moves to 34 from 28 balls.
Short and outside off, Edwards rocks back to cut but gets a bottom edge past short third man for a couple. The stand is worth 10 from 10 balls.
Double bluff. Forces the batsman to think that the length is going to be short by calling deep square leg in but then bowls it on a length outside off. Played straight to backward point.
Square leg comes in by around 5-10 metres.
Better ball, fill and outside off, coming in, left alone once again.
WIDE. Flirts with the wide guideline and pays the price for it outside off. Sangha lets it go.

EDGED, FOUR! Afghanistan are creating opportunities here. Might as well place attacking fields. Full and wide outside off, Edwards goes after it, looking to drive and gets a thick outside edge. It flies straight to where first slip would have been - but it is vacant and the keeper cannot get there with a dive.
Wide outside off, left alone. Lost his partner, so Edwards is a little watchful now.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

Huge LBW shout, but the impact is outside off. Full and outside off, Jason gets a big stride forward nd looks to block but wqears it on the pads. The bowler appeals but Sangha is well outside the line of off stump. 2 runs and a wicket from the over. 3-0-9-1 so far for Mujeeb.
Straight ball, pushed back to the bowler.
Up and running straightaway. A tad short around off, Sangha gets across and tucks it through fine leg for a couple.

OUT! Throws it away. Australia seem to have come out with a plan to go hammer and tongs against the new balls but in the process have lost a wicket. Full and outside off, Bryant looks to go over the top but does not have the elevation Finds Azmatullah at mid off who takes it with ease. 156 runs, 9 wickets, 267 balls - the equation.
Outside off, dead-batted to the off side.
Full and outside off, blocked gently towards backward point.

MISFIELD, FOUR! Short and outside off, Edwards cuts it straight to Zahir Khan at backward point who is late in getting down and the ball goes through! The bowler is very, very angry.
Full and just outside off, dabbed to point again.

Spoils the maiden. Full and outside off, swinging in a long way, JE looks to drive but the ball squirts off the inner half of the bat through square leg. A single.
This one comes back in, steered straight to backward point.
Outside off, left alone.

Another appeal, turned down once more. A short ball once more, outside off, Jack looks to pull but misses again.
A short ball outside off, Edwards looks to pull but misses. The keeper appeals but the umpire sinald one bouner for the over.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Goes back and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
On middle, worked through square leg.
Goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, pushed towards cover.
The ball has been square driven by the batsman.
Around off, swinging in, Jack works it off the inner half of the bat wide of mid on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! BEAUTY! Full and outside off, Edwards leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Naveen-ul-Haq to bowl with the second new ball.
Outside off, blocked superbly.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Down the leg side, Jack misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards square leg. A leg bye taken. 179 more needed from 297 balls now.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Outside off, cut to point for a couple.

Welcome back for the run chase. Interesting or expected? Mujeeb Zadran to start off the bowling. Max Bryant and Jack Edwards are the openers for Australia. Edwards to face. Here we go... 182 needed from 300 balls!
